alternates.name: Beneficiary Survey
alternates.designation: After returning from the mobility, the participant must provide the institutional coordinator with a certificate of stay
alternates.evidence_quote: After returning from the mobility, the participant must provide the institutional coordinator with a certificate of stay issued by the host institution. The certificate must include at least: the participant’s full name, the dates of stay, the signature, and the stamp of the responsible person. As a rule, this document is issued according to the host institution’s template. ... A Beneficiary Survey will be sent to the email address indicated in the financial agreement. Completing the survey is mandatory. In case of problems with the link, please contact the Erasmus coordinator.
